name: Patio Covers
summary: Custom patio covers designed for shade, weather protection and a finished connection to the home with coordinated framing, roofing and exterior details.

faqs.question: Can a patio cover attach to an existing roof?
faqs.answer: In many cases it can, but the connection, flashing, drainage and structural support must be evaluated before construction.

faqs.question: Do patio covers need permits?
faqs.answer: Permit requirements vary by city and depend on size, attachment method, structure and electrical work.
